verdict.rationale: Wrike's own docs say users can manage tasks, query projects and automate workflows through natural language, using MCP-connected assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. Wrike Copilot also answers questions and summarizes work, and AI Essentials includes natural-language automation rule generation. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of supported natural-language commands or actions, independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Manage tasks, query projects, and automate workflows through natural language.
Connect Wrike to Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and other AI assistants via MCP.
